questions.prompt: How many minutes are in a regular soccer half, before added time?
questions.explanation: A standard match has two 45-minute halves.

questions.prompt: Which soccer card signals a caution?
questions.explanation: Yellow is the caution card.

questions.prompt: Which soccer card sends a player off?
questions.explanation: Red means the player is sent off.

questions.prompt: How far is soccer's penalty spot from the goal line, in yards?
questions.explanation: The penalty mark is 12 yards from the goal line.

questions.prompt: In standard five-on-five basketball, how many points is a made free throw?
questions.explanation: A successful free throw scores one point.

questions.prompt: In five-on-five basketball, a made shot inside the three-point line scores how many points?
questions.explanation: An ordinary basket inside the arc scores two points.

questions.prompt: In five-on-five basketball, a made shot from beyond the arc scores how many points?
questions.explanation: A basket from beyond the three-point arc scores three.

questions.prompt: A basketball player makes a three-pointer plus one free throw. How many points is that?
questions.explanation: Three for the basket plus one for the free throw makes four.

questions.prompt: What number does 'love' mean in tennis scoring?
questions.explanation: Love is tennis's word for a zero score.

questions.prompt: What is a 40-40 tennis score called?
questions.explanation: When both sides reach 40, the score is deuce.

questions.prompt: In a normal tennis game, which score follows 30?
questions.explanation: The point scores go love, 15, 30, then 40.

questions.prompt: In standard advantage tennis, which score follows winning a point at deuce?
questions.explanation: Winning the point after deuce gives that side advantage.

questions.prompt: How many called balls give a baseball batter a walk?
questions.explanation: Four balls award the batter first base.

questions.prompt: How many strikes make a baseball strikeout?
questions.explanation: The third strike records a strikeout.

questions.prompt: How many outs normally end a baseball half-inning?
questions.explanation: Three outs finish the half-inning.

questions.prompt: How many runs score on a baseball grand slam?
questions.explanation: The batter and three baserunners all score.

questions.prompt: In standard beach volleyball doubles, how many players are on each team?
questions.explanation: Beach volleyball doubles uses two players per team.

questions.prompt: In international indoor volleyball, what is the fifth set's target score?
questions.explanation: The deciding fifth set goes to 15, with a two-point lead.

questions.prompt: In indoor volleyball, how many team hits are allowed besides a block?
questions.explanation: A team gets up to three hits in addition to a block.

questions.prompt: Which way do indoor volleyball players rotate when they gain the serve?
questions.explanation: The receiving team rotates one position clockwise.
